rules.current: a current record on a reference host, at the standard size, whose release_pin is not behind the catalogue pin
rules.missing: no record, or the current record is a size_fallback row (human ruling 2026-10-23: standard-size cells covered only by size_fallback rows are missing)
rules.parity: per planned setup cell: match/diverged from its current parity record, not_assessed from parity_witnesses, else missing
rules.stale: a current standard-size record whose release_pin is behind the catalogue pin (the envelope release_pin, else the newest record pin) or is not recorded
rules.superseded: only superseded records on the key
